claims.summary: Munhoz and Naves (2012) distinguish genitive/whole–part topic-subject constructions, exemplified by O meu carro furou o pneu, from locative/theme–place constructions, exemplified by Essa casa bate bastante sol; their paper analyzes these as structurally heterogeneous patterns.

claims.sectionKey: Distinción de otras construcciones con tópico
claims.summary: Melo and Cavalcante (2020) describe left dislocation, topicalization associated with an empty position, and topic-subject constructions as distinct categories in their discussion of Brazilian Portuguese marked topics.

locator.description: PDF pp. 245–246, abstract and examples (1a–b): O meu carro furou o pneu / Essa casa bate bastante sol; PDF pp. 251–253, section 2, distinguishes whole–part genitive from theme–place locative readings and describes their different argument structures.

links.notes: La ficha atribuye la clasificación y el análisis a este artículo, sin generalizarlos como consenso.

locator.description: Section “O tópico sujeito como posse externa”, lines 189–207: introduces topic-subject as a distinct construction and frames its analysis around external possession.

links.notes: Fuente de contraste para restringir esta ficha a tópico-sujeto y no mezclarla con toda topicalización.

locator.description: Section on marked topics, lines 152–189: separately discusses left dislocation (152–167), antitopicalization (169–174), topicalization (175–188), then begins the topic-subject analysis at line 189.

links.notes: La clasificación explícita sostiene la distinción editorial de la ficha.
